passage.text: I read your column every week, and I hope you can help me.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈriːd jʊr ˈkɑːləm ˈɛvri ˈwiːk, ənd aɪ ˈhoʊp juː kən ˈhɛlp miː.

passage.text: My best friend and I have known each other since high school, and we have always done everything together.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈbɛst ˈfrɛnd ənd aɪ hæv ˈnoʊn ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðər sɪns ˈhaɪ ˌskuːl, ənd wiː hæv ˈɔːlweɪz ˈdʌn ˈɛvriθɪŋ təˈɡɛðər.

passage.text: But two weeks ago, she stopped talking to me.
passage.reading: bʌt ˈtuː ˈwiːks əˈɡoʊ, ʃiː ˈstɑːpt ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə miː.

passage.text: She ignores my messages, and at university she sits with other people.
passage.reading: ʃiː ɪɡˈnɔːrz maɪ ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz, ənd ət ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ʃiː ˈsɪts wɪð ˈʌðər ˈpiːpəl.

passage.text: I don't know what I did wrong.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ ˈwʌt aɪ ˈdɪd ˈrɔːŋ.

passage.text: Maybe it's a misunderstanding, but I'm too scared to ask her.
passage.reading: ˈmeɪbi ɪts ə ˌmɪsʌndərˈstændɪŋ, bʌt aɪm ˈtuː ˈskɛrd tə ˈæsk hɜːr.

passage.text: I feel very lonely without her. What should I do?
passage.reading: aɪ ˈfiːl ˈvɛri ˈloʊnli wɪˈðaʊt hɜːr. ˈwʌt ʃʊd aɪ ˈduː?

passage.text: If I were you, I would talk to your friend face to face.
passage.reading: ɪf aɪ wɜːr juː, aɪ wʊd ˈtɔːk tə jʊr ˈfrɛnd ˈfeɪs tə ˈfeɪs.

passage.text: Invite her for coffee somewhere quiet, and talk things over.
passage.reading: ɪnˈvaɪt hɜːr fər ˈkɔːfi ˈsʌmwɛr ˈkwaɪət, ənd ˈtɔːk ˈθɪŋz ˈoʊvər.

passage.text: Tell her that you miss her and that you want to understand what happened.
passage.reading: ˈtɛl hɜːr ðæt juː ˈmɪs hɜːr ənd ðæt juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˌʌndərˈstænd ˈwʌt ˈhæpənd.

passage.text: Many problems between friends start with a small misunderstanding.
passage.reading: ˈmɛni ˈprɑːbləmz bɪˈtwiːn ˈfrɛndz ˈstɑːrt wɪð ə ˈsmɔːl ˌmɪsʌndərˈstændɪŋ.

passage.text: A good friend will listen. Good luck!
passage.reading: ə ˈɡʊd ˈfrɛnd wɪl ˈlɪsən. ˈɡʊd ˈlʌk!
